data.one_liner: Widget that makes it easy to implement a custom pull to refresh gesture.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CustomRefreshIndicator and CustomMaterialIndicator widget to build completely custom pull-to-refresh gestures and animations for scrollable widgets. It manages states like idle, dragging, armed, and loading, letting developers design unique pull-to-refresh experiences.
use_when: You want to build a custom pull-to-refresh animation or UI design.
You need a pull-to-refresh gesture on horizontal lists or from both edges.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material or Cupertino refresh indicator without modifications.
strengths: Extremely flexible custom indicator builder with full state tracking.
Supports both leading and trailing edges, plus horizontal lists.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation for custom animations and transforms.
Custom indicators must be built from scratch.
